purpose: One further local-validation refinement around 006, using existing MF, PPR, rules and popularity only. Declare the entire grid before scoring.
selection: Highest all_primary MAP@5 among thirteen new configurations whose full validation lists do not duplicate uploads 001-006; tie by config ID. Report 006 as fixed control. Template results and paired intervals are diagnostics only. No grid expansion after scores; no Kaggle score/CSV loaded by the selector.
protocol: Unchanged strict >=80% truth, 4030 primary/1150 nested template users, 6384 candidates, repeats, denominator five, original method hyperparameters and seed.

semantics.cf: Model-specific mass-preserving half-life counts, as 006; raw binary PPR graph unchanged. Null means the original undecayed component.
semantics.rules: Optional recency affects log-count antecedent query weights only, using >=80%-qualified airings. The same weekly mined rules matrix is reused; it is never remined with validation labels.
semantics.popularity: Optional recency affects the RRF popularity voting list only, aggregated from >=50%-qualified airings. Original unweighted popularity remains the tie-break, positive-signal backfill and common cold fallback.
semantics.time: Use last observed overlap to the applicable training cutoff; scale positive event weights globally to preserve each threshold's original qualifying-airing mass. All history and positive support retained. Same rule at May18 validation and July27 final cutoff.

limits: Single repeatedly used temporal hold-out; diagnostics are conditional, not corrected for selection. Aggregate Kaggle feedback motivates the question but cannot choose a configuration. Only one new CSV is prepared.
